blocks.text: Creamline regrouped after an extended opening frame loss, repelling Galeries Tower in four sets, 27-29, 25-18, 25-19, 25-18, in the Siklab series of the 2026 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference on Saturday at the Filoil Centre in San Juan.
